title: Apple restricts dating apps and AI companions to users 18 and up
summary: Apple's new App Store rules will require 18+ ratings for dating apps and AI companions that offer sexual or romantic content.
reason: Apple's App Store age-rating change is a private platform/self-regulatory policy, not a government law, regulation, or enforcement action (rule 4-1 excludes industry self-regulation). It is not a model release, research artifact, business event, or OSS tool, so no rule covers it.
